company_info.company_description: "At Greenwiring, we believe that our customers deserve the best. For this reason, we have aligned ourselves with industry leaders. Our Australian-based suppliers provide and guarantee products of the highest quality that are suitable for Australia’s unique environment."

reviews.review_description: Straight talking, minus the b's. Removal of older 3kw system.All the info needed for upgrading and again solid advice when talking 'needs verses hype' about battery installation. Punctual, polite by all the team. No negatives....Highly recommended. Well done team.
The price is reasonable and the installation is good , happy choice.

Stev was on time and always  communicated  with me. Managed to get the installation done before install date .installation  was neat and installers were well versed in their job. Would recommend to anyone  looking for solar
Sales process was great - all my queries were addressed and options discussed

No dramas from initial site visit to quote to final install. Very happy with the non pushy approach and ease around the process even when we decided to change the inverter prior to install. The guys that did the install were neat and tidy and all works completed with no mess or damage in half a day. Would recommend to others in the future.

I called Green Wiring based on a recommendation from a friend who had also referred many of her other friends because she was so happy with their service and install.  Steve came to my house that same afternoon for a quote and explained the products and process clearly.  We booked in for about a month later, but there was a cancellation so got a booking within 2 weeks of our quote.  They explained the requirements by Western Power to change over the meter and the costs and process with that also.Green Wiring's team had great communication throughout the whole process and what to expect with the installation, which went off without a hitch. The install team were friendly and efficient and explained how to use the system and how to connect the inverter to the app to see how the system worked.The after-care service was great also. I highly recommend using Green Wiring, we got a great deal on our 15 panels and 5k inverter, and were very impressed with their service and value.
2nd property I have used this company for solar. Very friendly, good communication and customer service
Very smooth and honest that’s what I value the most.
Straight forward job, all people involved seemed genuine and happy (on Day 1) with installation and it's working.
The process was smooth from start to finish, so far the system is running well.

The quote was very competitive - much better than the one we got from a 'door knocker'.The installation was very simple, the installers were on time, polite and efficient and always made sure that what they were doing was acceptable to us.They also removed our old 1.5KW system that they had installed about 15 years ago (which was still working fine but no longer fit for purpose).The only thing that could be improved is to provide a short set of dot points to inform ( remind ) owners what might come after installation.- explain the odd set of symbols on the Status that relate to when there are network voltage limitations,- Synergy may disconnect the system for a short while to test they can shut it down.-  Synergy will change the meter reader.Overall - highly recommended
Selected due to their high rating and was not disappointed. Very happy with the work completed and the system.

Salesperson Steve was very easy to get on with, whereas another with whom we'd had a phone quote from, was Very upset when I emailed him to say that we'd gone with another company. I was told by Steve that installation was going to be the following Wednesday, but a day or so later, phoned to say that the installer was double booked, so we got it the following Wednesday.Removal of the previous installation & the new install was very efficient. The only thing that I wasn't aware of was that the new inverter would be smaller & be higher than the previous one, which meant that two new holes for the cabling were drilled, leaving the previous holes underneath, exposed. It's left to the owner to fill the holes which are 30 mm wide.The electrician showed us how the system worked & did the connections to the grid through his company.
Polite, punctual and tide from point of consideration to installation
Green Wiring are easy to deal with, competitive pricing, responsive to queries and would use again.
I have another house to get solar on and will use Green Wiring for sure, great to deal with and was happy with the finish job.

Green wiring were great from start to finish, they made it straight forward and easy. They were the only ones to attend to quote, but were not pushy. We liked that they used their own installers who were fantastic.

Right from the first visit I was made to feel comfortable. They were open and honest. The installation was quick with no fuss. The after sales service was excellent. All questions raised were answered.

Under stinking hot conditions the guys came and very efficiently got our install done with no tiles damaged, everything cleaned up afterwards. Helped us with the technology side of things and explained it all to us and were still smiling under very trying conditions.

Green Wiring is a family owned Perth company, which is well established. I felt informed and not pressured by the sales rep during the quoting process,  and was able to independently research the recommended products, which had excellent reviews. I was able to converse directly with the owner as well, which was reassuring. The installers were punctual, polite and efficient. They worked hard all day, removing all the old solar panels and inverter, installing the new - giving me options as to the location of the inverter - and leaving no damage or mess. They ensured the connection to the grid, and explained how to use the app on my phone. I like how this company is local, and I feel confident in their knowledge, service and ongoing availability.
Being my third quote, I had a bit of knowledge by then, so the quoting process was relatively quick. The installers were polite and punctual. They organized the grid connection after the install.
Competitively priced and worked with me to use my preferred panels/inverter, would highly recommend.
Sales person was polite and knowledgeable.Installation went smoothly, tradesmen were professional.System appears to be working well.

Green Wiring are a family run business and have been in operation for over 15 years. No sales pitch, they offered to come around and quote however I knew the system I wanted so I sent photographs of roof area and my meter box and they gave me a written quote (email). They even offered to remove the old system for nothing. No complaints working as expected and in time for summer.
Sales process was great, did comparison and got the information we wanted. Installation was seamless. They completed the grid connection paperwork so was very easy
Each aspect of the purchase and installation process went very smoothly and how I expected.  You couldn't ask for more.

Steve came and visited my house to quote and was really friendly and down to earth. He took time to look at my current bills and explained how much we'd need/what we'd saved based on units (kWh) and it just made so much sense and what made sense from an installation point of view. Gave plenty of options and the guys that came and installed it were professional and did a great job. Got a good number of panels to fit and no ties were broken.

Sales person visited and explained the systems and options well (as did all three that quoted per Finn's recommendation).  Installation was fast and efficient, despite patchy rain on the day.  Goodwe inverter setup was simple (happy with no noise from inverter). Just installed today, so we'll see how it goes.
Had an issue but complaint rectified today and thanks for the same. The system is under warranty.
From initial contact fro quote to on time installation the quality of service was faultless. The system was installed in half a day with full function and grid connection confirmed.
Process from quote to installation was no hassles.Staff were friendly and easy to deal with.Would recommend.
From start to completion Green Wiring where excellent.Good communication Good pricing and no pushy sales talk.Installers were neat and tidied up after themselves. Took all the packaging away too.
Steve's quote was the best of the three I received.The installation went smoothly, the guys were polite, tidy and punctual.

What stood out to me was that Steve (sales) was willing to schedule work without taking a deposit. This indicated a lot of confidence in his price and quality. Looking back, it was a clever psychological play on my comitment bias! Green wiring were quite a bit cheaper than the other quotes requested through solarquotes, one of the companies sent by solarquotes semed really disinterested.I elected to to puchase the Goodwe HK1000 consumption monitor. Note, this is installed at your switchboard and takes up 4 DIN slots. Add another MCB for solar isolation and you will need 5 DINs available! However it does give me quite a bit of information about my consumption patterns, although the goodwe site isn't great and only refreshes in 2.5 min intervals. Also, I suspect that the HK1000 will be required if I did want a battery later.I did not elect to go with a hybrid inverter and if it makes financial sense later, I will go with AC coupled batteries (I didn't want to risk a hybrid inverter which had narrow battery compatiblity in the future). My extrapolation from the HK1000 indicates that the payoff time for batteries would be 7.5 years. My inverter was the GW5000D-NS.I do want to point out that the goodwe inverter acts as a wifi client as well as a wifi access point (for future support), as does the HK1000. I don't particularly like this as it uses default passwords to connect as well as admin! I plan to buy the lan dongle for the inverter and remove its wifi functionality. The HK1000 also features an ethernet connection which I plan to use; its position experiences poor wifi signal strength right now.I highly encourage you to visit tradezone.com.au and sign up for a free account which will let you see approx cost prices for each component for your system. This will arm you with the knowledge needed to keep quotes in check.With regards to installation, a few minor issues occured. Roof tiles were chipped off with a hammer which I feel was an unnecessarily risky way to work. I have spotted a few small chips in traversed tiles too. This is probably just something you have to expect with roof work.From a layout/design perspective, I have not seen a voltage-indicated advantage by splitting 25% of my panels to face the west. The string facing west vs north reached equal voltage at about 4pm, when I was already ramping down to a 6pm shutoff. While its great in theory to "flatten the curve", the generation results indicate this isn't a worthwhile approach.

I had no issues at all with Greenwiring. Everything was done on time and as planned. All questions were clarified up front. Neat and timely job. It is now 4 years since the installation was completed and its going great.

Steve the sales guy got in touch soon after I requested a quote and was on site for a chat within a few days. Provided all the information I required. Advice to use SolarEdge optimisers instead of micro inverters was spot on and also consistent with the advice provided by the other companies I spoke to.Installation was without hassles, team turned up on time and cleaned up everything before they left. Team leader Dean communicated well and showed me how the SolarEdge app works before he left.

Sales rep was enthusiastic and answered all my questions, and gave a reasonable quote.Only slight red flag (if you'd even call it that) was that he was trying to talk me out of the consumption meter.Install went well, and installers were good to deal with.However, again the (lead?) installer tried to talk me out of the consumption meter.The installers were able to squeeze the inverter in exactly where I wanted it, which I was very happy with.Install was done, however the Inverter wouldn't start producing power, due to apparently there being too much voltage on the grid. So the Installer booked an appointment with Western Power to see if they could lower the voltage.Before the installer left, the system kicked on and started producing power, however the website and app wasn't showing any power being produced (even though this was showing on the Inverter, and the datalogger was appearing on the website).This was left over the weekend, however early Monday morning, Website and App started showing power being produced (apparently Solis support did something on their end). But still no power consumption. The consumption meter I was sold, I believe was slightly different to what the sales rep showed me, being a "wired to the Inverter" version, rather than a Wireless/Wi-Fi version. Talking to the installer, it sounded like it was the first time they had installed this type, which is manufactured by a 3rd party, rather than Solis themselves.Then later in the day, Installer came back, and speaking to a colleague on the phone, got the consumption meter working and the data displaying on the app.Overall and in the end, very happy with the service, install and equipment. I'll see how things are going in 12 months time...

The quality of the service was excellent.We had 3 companies who were going to contact us. The first company said they were unable to visit us until a time in the future but we were ready to go ahead straight away and a future appointment was not preferred.Green Wiring contacted us and suggested a time in the near future. We told them that this was a problem and that we were over 90% committed to go ahead. Green Wiring wanted our work and agreed to visit us the following evening.Steve contacted us the next day to confirm the time for that evening. (We were impressed 2 contacts within 24 hours, he obviously wanted our custom) and then he rocked up on time.We had previously had another company around to quote and while the rep was friendly she was evasive on a couple of my questions.Steve had no such aversion to answering my questions and he impressed us with his expertise.He was not phased when we said we asked for an installation date. Steve gave us a choice of two. We selected the first available time and Steve told us the process from there. He explained that Western Power would be around to change the meter system to digital. We were contacted by Green Wiring at least4 times after the quote acceptance and the installation. Honestly we did not have to do a thing after we gave Green Wiring the go ahead, The installers arrived on time on the agreed day and went about the installation in a most professional manner. When asked how long the installation would take the installer said they would be gone by 2.30. They were finished by 1PM.Under promised and over delivered which impressed us.Indeed Green Wiring did not make any rash promises they merely told us what would happen and within what time frame. Great company to deal with and we would recommend them to friends.We also appreciated Solar Quotes follow up and interest in the process. Your comments on the several  you tube sessions were very informative and helped to allay any worries we might have.

Green Wiring visited my house to give me a quote for a solar system. They asked what I wanted and I told them that I wanted, amongst other things, a system that had the ability to monitor consumption. I also told them that I had already received a quote that provided me with this requirement. The Snake Oil Salesman asked me what inverter I had been quoted and I told him. I even told him what price I had been quoted. He said that the Fronius inverter, although more expensive, was a far better product as it was manufactured in Europe and provided everything, and more, than the Chinese inverter that I had been quoted. The Snake Oil Salesman persuaded me to go down the more expensive inverter route on the clear understanding that, I thought, I was still getting what I had been quoted by the other provider, "and more".I signed a one page Contract with them which had the words ``Consumption meter discussed - Yes" and a date by when the installation had to take place as I was leaving for overseas on holiday. After the installation, which took place on the agreed date without any real problems, I went onto the Fronius website to monitor the solar production and compare it with my household consumption only to find that I was not able to monitor consumption. I phoned the Snake Oil Salesman to ask him what I was doing wrong as I was unable to monitor consumption. He advised that a consumption meter was not included in the price and to install one would cost $750. Alternatively, he said, I could go online and purchase a third party consumption monitor, which was easy to install, for a fraction of the price.I sent Green Wiring an email explaining that I had not received what had been 'sold to me' and in addition the installers had dislodged a number of roof tiles that required rectifying. I told them that I would be deferring the payment until we had jointly resolved the issues at hand. I received no response, either by phone or by email, over the following 4 days before I flew out to the UK. I received an email 6 days after I left the country stating that they had entered my property and rectified the roof tiles and disconnected the system! They claim that they unsuccessfully attempted to contact me by phone so they took it upon themselves to enter my property and decommission the system. Their action is tantamount to trespassing in my book and as such they illegally gained access to my property.I have since paid for the installation in full although I am far from happy as I strongly believe that I have been conned. So my advice to anyone that is considering using Green Wiring is beware the Snake Oil Salesman and make sure that the Contract that they ask you to sign includes everything that you think you are getting because if you don't they will have an excuse to get out of something
From Quote to finished instal could not have ask for better. Would recommend AAA +

Steve from Green Wiring was great throughout the whole process. We received a fantastic quote, and ocked in an install date all in one day.  The team were punctual and the job was completed in half a day.  Very happy with the whole process.

All good except escution cut-out on switch board.Was done with angle grinder not file and drill.So sloppy work there.was surprised as all the other work was good.Next issue is synenergy in Western Australia are only giving 2 cents buyback,that needs to change as there is no incentive for people to go solar.The only reason I did is to charge my ev and I consume 8 to 9 kwh per day with that.

Only quoter to call and not just email a questionnaire, Steve was open and honest when he came onsite to quote, grid connection was arranged before install, installers were punctual, polite, tidy, and went the extra mile.
Highly recommend Green Wiring, from start to finish. Best price for Goodwe inverter and Canadian panels.The installation was easy and to a very high standard. Thankyou to the Green Wiring team.
Friendly, knowledgeable salesman - answered all my questions. Great price for good quality components
Only company to actually do a site visit to quote. Managed to bring installation date early. Install was tidy. Connection all done for us. Happy

The experience right from Steve explaining what's right for us to the experienced installation team, to the quality materials used was just great. Kenny was great with answering all my after installation questions.. Very happy with solar quotes who were prompt with recommending installers and so happy I shortlisted Green wiring. The quality of the PV system and price given was great value. I got a 6.6kw qcell and fronius symo combination. Highly recommend them for quality, honest and value quotes.
The process was very easy. Steve came to my place, open to answer all of our questions. Very happy with the outcome

Sales process - quick and professional. Was good to have the information from SolarQuotes to be able to answer the questions on the spot and correctly.Installation - date was moved up by a month which was great. Chaps arrived on time and finished early.Overall customer services - great, would definitely recommend this installer
Sale and quoting process was easy and informativeInstallation team were excellent. Were able to schedule us in earlier than expected and installation was quick and professional
Just went in today so need to wait and see how it goes but see above for service and price info
The whole process, from the beginning to the end was very smooth, with no problems. The installers gave full briefing at the end and left the work area as they found it.

Salesman talked us through what we needed. installers left a dozen or so metal clamp things on the roof which probably would have rusted up there. Apart from that they were very neat and tidy cleaning up most of the dust etc  when drilling through the carport wall. wi fi is playing up a bit meaning i have to reset it every time i want to look at the daily production but i haven't yet contacted them for a fix. all in all I'm very happy with the system installed and am looking forward to our next power bill.i was not home for the install but the wife tells me the team leader on the install was very nicePerth Solar Force wanted to make sure I had 20 roof tiles spare to replace broken ones but our installers did not break any
The sales/quoting process was easy. Installation was brought forward due to an opening in their availability. Install went fine, looks tidy.
Great salesperson and great installation. People were friendly and professional

Overall, an enjoyable process and streamlined sale. Beside the initial assessment, there was very little left to do on my part. All paperwork (notices, registration, rebates) were taken care of by the installer. I spent the day overseeing the installation and doing the wifi setup with them. Made the payment and presto! Solar installation complete. The successful supplier came in $1000 less than their competitors, with similar, if not the same, offering. Although he knew I had met others, I didn't bother with horse trading so simply asked him for his best price - glad I did.

I went ahead with a company called Green Wiring who I would recommend to anyone. The salesman was polite, informative and helpful and the installers were professional and explained the system well. I would recommend this company highly to anyone considering a solar system

Personable and honest interaction through the sales process.Company is well managed and efficient it seems.All very easy and everything was checked with owner before making any decisions and starting installation.

Sales person got in touch within 2hrs and was onsite with a plan the next day.Did not try to push any brands and was upfront about the available options. Taught me what to look out for during installation.Actually talked me out of spending on extras.Replied to my email questions with a call within a day. Organised everything with Western Powers without a problem.Installers were on time and polite. When they realised that the panels wouldn't fit the way we wanted, they suggested a compromise without being pushy.All done by 2pm (could be earlier if they didn't have to remove the old solar system first) and helped me get setup with the app.

I’m very happy overall with my solar / inverter. I’m in my 4th week after install and so far so good. The installers were great and  I was home during the install and they kept me informed. The overall the process was smooth. My only small difficulty was, because I have a chimney shading I may have needed an optimiser (depending on final panel install location) and they were not forthcoming with options for optimum design in this regard nor initially with having an optimiser available with the install crew just in case. But they did agree to this, and to be fair didn’t need it in the end and overall I’m very happy with Green Wiring and can recommend them.
Quoting was easy and informative.Installation punctual, quick, with helpful advice on positioning etc.All grid connection etc. was all done for us.

Very prompt and neat workmanship, 2 of the 3 houses done; 3rd programned for 29/11.An issue arose, and was a coincidence in that a fault appeared post-install with the Western Power mains switch on unit b: the switch heated up and failed. Kenny from Green Wiring came promply and checked the install and found no fault then noticed the western power switch at the edge of the property and alerted western power, who were quick to cut all power, but slow to reconnect when my electrician replaced the switch.  That switch was also used previously when Western Power upgraded the meter box. Suspected loose wire causing arcing.

The salesperson from Greenwiring was informative, helpful, and able to answer all our questions.Our meter box had to be upgraded by Western Power, and this was organised through Greenwiring and done promptly.The installers worked on a wet and windy day so had to take breaks, but the process was finished on the day and the men were polite and hardworking.The system started working immediately and any questions I have had I have been able to call Greenwiring and get information straight away.

After getting 3 companies to obtain quotes from, Green Wiring made the first move, Steve arrived for quote, prepared with a drawing of how it could be installed, answered my questions, gave me a quote and I ended up going with them. Early bird gets the job.The guys had pre-arranged the Bi-directional meter install for me.My Install was 3wks earlier than planned, due to another customer not being ready, so the guys arrived at 8.30am, and started work, I  was WFH so I checked on them a few times, seemed like they were doing a good job, power was off only for 20mins, then they were done by 1pm. The guys explained how it worked and programmed it up for me. They even replaced a few tiles that were pre-broken by others, so I was very impressed by that. Overall a positive experience.

Fantastic service which started with the sales person Steve, and including customer service and the installer Dean and his men. Very polite and friendly, we have no complaints and can easily recommend Green Wiring to people looking to install a solar system.

Arrived on time and I was most impressed with both workers.left my premises clean and tidy explained everything about the system to me and put the ap on my phone so I can easily monitor the system.No complaints at all.
Sales quoting process very goodInstallation very good on all aspects of the jobCustomer service also very good
Prompt service, well explained and great follow up service. The guys cleaned up after themselves, stack away the old system and set up the app ready for use.
We were extremely impressed with the whole service that was provided to us. From quoting, installation, explanation of the system, there is nothing we could be critical of.

Great service from the quotation stage to installation and after service follow up.Genuine information to assist with making informed decision, as to the brand and size of the required solar system.I will be highly recommend Green Wiring to my family and friends.

My existing old inverter died only a week before I sold the house. I contacted Green Wiring and they arranged to visit very promptly. The tech was on time and brought everything he needed to deal with any eventuality. He quickly diagnosed the inverter had died and explained his reasoning in a logical, non-technical way. He very efficiently installed a new inverter - which was a very reasonable price. I used my mobile phone to film him giving efficient, clear instructions about the new system so I could send it to the new owner. The new owner and I were both really relieved this problem was resolved so easily.

Exceptional customer service. Quote was below what I expected. Everything was explained clearly. The crew who came to install were on time, friendly, explained every step and spotless in their cleaning up.  All in all a stress free experience.  They phoned a few weeks after install to check there were no issues and there wasn't and I don't expect there to be in the future.

Green Wiring are a all round professional team from initial sales/quote to installation and then owners courtesy call after the work had been completed. Excellent customer service, should be a model for all businesses

Steve came to my house and talked to me for about 30 minutes about the best option for our setup. He was very friendly, approachable and explained everything perfectly, and offered me a fantastic price. Green Wiring organized for the meter to be upgraded about 2 weeks later (took ~5-10 minutes).The installers did a fantastic job, arrived on time and explained the use of the system so I can monitor its performance. The installation itself is very clean and I'm very happy with how it turned out.Wouldn't hestitate to recommend Green Wiring to anyone looking for a solar installation.

The salesperson was friendly and offered a range of products which the company uses. We discussed how the installation of solar would benefit our particular situation and we chose the products that we had researched. All our questions were answered with detailed explanations. The quotation offered at the end of the discussion was very competitive.The company arranged for the changing of our meter to a digital instrument prior to installation of the solar system.The installation was carried out by two people and they did an excellent job. They arrived on time and before the work started they optimized the positioning of the panels on the roof as they would be on three roof slopes and have to take into account other air cooling and pool heating systems on the roof. A small number of roof tiles were broken during the installation and replaced, and they also identified and replaced an additional cracked tile which had produced water staining on the eaves. The installation work was carried out efficiently and professionally during what was quite a windy and showery day.The system was up and running and explained/demonstrated before the people left.

I had a very seamless experience with this company from start to finish. All the people I dealt with were very friendly and helpful. I cant tell how much money I will save as yet as Perth has had the wettest July for over 20 years.

All sales people were good, polite and not pushy at all and explained products and gave good advice, the install went without a hitch and was neat and tidy and carried out a week before schedule due to a cancellation, all paperwork and grid connection done by company. Just waiting on my first electricity bill to see if it was all worth it.

Had a few sales reps come out to quote and the Green Wirings rep was the most direct. non-pushy rep I had. Installation had to be rescheduled last minute when their installer called in sick that day, hence the 4 stars, but when they did come out I couldn't fault the install. Customer services throughout the process has been great - quick and efficient. Highly recommended!

First of all, is like to say I was very happy with the product and service I got. Everything went smoothly from the start to the end. I got a quote from Steve. He informed me Green Wiring was able to any product I wanted so he was not pushy at all. So I decided to go with GoodWe inverter which comes with a 10 year warranty and Sun Tech panels with a 15 year warranty.He then said the office will get in touch to organise when the PV will be installed. I spoke to and corresponded via email to Sia from the office a few times before and after the installation. I asked a few things about the products and how it is installed. Her response was very swift and polite. If she didn't know the answer, she found out for me. As for installation, Aaron was very professional and explained how they were going to install and how long it would take.I definitely recommend their services.

Sales process was done in under 30 mins offering a combination of inverters and panels with facts and figures behind each.  No nonsense sales process.  We booked the installation and the guys turned up exactly on time.  Got 18 panels up and running within 5 hours and we haven’t looked back. The power usage chart on our synergy account clearly shows when the solar was turned on.  We have less than halved our electricity bill. At this rate we will got our money back within 2 years and be seeing the savings in our pocket.  Would 100% recommend Green Wiring.
The process was as expected without surprises and that's all I really ask for.

We had 3 different quotes all the companies were punctual and polite. We found that we learnt different aspects from each company so by the end of the process we felt we understood exactly what we could expect. In the end we went for the cheapest quote because they offered a choice of panels and inverters. Installation was on time and the installers were punctual, polite and took all the rubbish away, installer also had discussion on site regarding the proposed  placement of panels and a change was made on-site as it was suggested this was going to be of greater benefit. All grid connection and informing of power company were undertaken by Green Wiring. It was a seamless process and no payment was required until installation.

Quote was done in person by knowledgeable salesman who explained everything well. Good that any system can be sourced, not limited in choice. Meter and grid connection all organised flawlessly.There were some hiccups on installation, bit of a mess left behind on the roof and out of level panels, but when I made a post installation phone call these things were fixed up promptly and without hassle, good customer service.Very happy with the inverter and panels so far, and have only seen a few weeks of winter performance.
Sales person was friendly, offered a good deal on the day of meeting so signed up straight away. Happy with products used and price offered.Very low fuss, no frills if you like.

All salesman were polite but I use the “would I buy a used car from this man” as a gauge.Two didn’t really listen to what I wanted.One was very inflexible on panel layoutOne I chose discussed all my wants and was able to satisfy me with just a bit of compromise.He wasn’t cheapest quote but was for the panels and inverter I wanted.As it was only fitted yesterday 16/7/20 it is too early to gauge the efficiency.

Steve at Green Wiring was punctual polite and made the process easy to understand. I was told Green Wiring are not affiliated with any brand which I liked. No payment until after the installation is completed.System due to be installed on April so cannot comment on installation yet.
Quoting process was simple, straightforward, clear information. Timing to install was appropriate, technicians were careful, thorough, communicative.It was up and working without fuss.
Very helpful salesperson and office staff. Installers on time and made a few adjustments eg. positioning of some panels, with consultation with us. Everything was well organised and went smoothly.

I’ve just had my solar installed by Green Wiring (Perth WA) and they were brilliant from start to finish. Sales rep was wonderful and explained everything I needed to know and more. The admin And sales team kept me up to Date along the way. The installation day came and the guys were very polite, cleaned up after themselves and set me up on the internet. I highly recommend them.

Received an onsite quote from Green Wiring which was informative and competitive. The salesman explained differences in system components and offered advice on layout and expected returns and performance etc.Installation was booked in and no payment was requested until “the system is installed and we are happy”.We were called two weeks ahead of schedule to ask if we wanted an earlier install date, which we were more than happy with.Installation was efficient and very professional with the whole system installed and operating within one day. The installers did a very professional install, gave us a briefing on operation and left our the site without any mess.Thanks for a great job, will be definitely recommending Green Wiring to my friends and Family.

From the first enquire phone call, to the personal home visit quote, right to the very end with a follow up post installation call, Green Wiring have been pleasant and easy to deal with.
